meta.title: UK to EU HS code master
meta.note: All codes are strings. Classification is indicative; the exporter is legally responsible for the code declared.

SPS_CHECK.label: Animal-origin or composite food
SPS_CHECK.note: Products of animal origin (honey, dairy, meat, fish) and some composite foods containing them need an Export Health Certificate and EU border control post checks. Many shelf-stable composites are exempt - check EU rules before shipping.

PHYTO_CHECK.label: Plant health
PHYTO_CHECK.note: Live plants, seeds, cut flowers and some plant products need a phytosanitary certificate and pre-notification to the EU. Most processed foods are exempt.

EXCISE.label: Excise goods
EXCISE.note: Alcohol, tobacco and nicotine products carry excise duty in the destination EU country. B2C shipping usually needs a fiscal representative and many carriers refuse them.

NICOTINE.label: Nicotine / vaping
NICOTINE.note: E-liquids and vapes face Tobacco Products Directive notification, nicotine limits and national bans on cross-border distance selling.

COSMETICS.label: Cosmetics
COSMETICS.note: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009: an EU-based Responsible Person and a CPNP notification are required before placing on the EU market.

TOYS.label: Toys
TOYS.note: EU Toy Safety rules: CE marking and an EU economic operator are required. UKCA alone is not accepted in the EU.

BATTERY_LI.label: Lithium battery
BATTERY_LI.note: Contains or is a lithium battery: dangerous-goods shipping rules apply (UN3480/3481/3090/3091). Check carrier limits.

EXPORT_CONTROL.label: Possible export control
EXPORT_CONTROL.note: Some versions may need an export licence (dual-use). Check the UK Export Control Joint Unit checker.

HS2028.label: HS 2028 watch
HS2028.note: This heading area is named in the HS 2028 amendments (in force 1 Jan 2028). Re-check the code against the correlation tables before 2028.

restricted_terms.pepper spray: Classed as a prohibited weapon in the UK; do not ship.
restricted_terms.cbd: CBD rules differ by EU country and novel-food status; check destination rules before shipping.
restricted_terms.knife: Many carriers restrict knives; some EU countries restrict sale to under-18s.
restricted_terms.firework: Explosives - dangerous goods; specialist carriers only.
restricted_terms.nail polish: Flammable liquid - dangerous goods limits apply.
restricted_terms.perfume: Flammable liquid - dangerous goods limits apply.
restricted_terms.medicine: Medicines need marketing authorisation in the EU country; usually cannot be sold cross-border.
restricted_terms.seed: Plant health certificate may be needed.
restricted_terms.vape: Nicotine products: excise and national distance-selling bans.

ambiguous_terms.pants: UK: underwear (6107/6108). US: trousers (6203/6204). Ask which.
ambiguous_terms.tablet: Computer tablet (84713000) or Scottish tablet confectionery (17049075).
ambiguous_terms.case: Phone case, suitcase, laptop case or display case - ask what kind.
ambiguous_terms.set: A set mixing different goods may need classifying by the item giving essential character - ask what is in it.
